scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Finally, it's time...
Hey, what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
終於到了時候...
嘿，你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
{0}?
Got it. I'll remember your name.
A master told me that you are a person with ability.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
{0}？
明白了。我會記住你的名字。
師父告訴我，你是一個有才能的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
What? You are a distrustful person.
Hmm, whatever.
I heard that you are a person with ability.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
什麼？你是個多疑的人。
嗯，算了。
我聽說你是一個有才能的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
My duty is delivering a guild message to a capable assassin.
I think that you are suitable to perform the guild's duty.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
我的職責是將公會的訊息傳達給有能力的刺客。
我認為你適合執行公會的任務。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
So, would you perform this duty for us?
Of course, I'm going to offer a reward for completing your task.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
那麼，你願意為我們執行這個任務嗎？
當然，完成任務後我會提供獎勵。

scripts.text: What is the request?
scripts.translation: 有什麼要求？

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
It's unclear.
I told you. It's a special task.
The only thing I know is the condition to bring a person with the master's ability.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
不清楚。
我告訴過你，這是一個特殊任務。
我只知道需要找一個擁有師父般能力的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
First, one who has patience.
Second, one who is quiet.
Third, one who is focused.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
第一，要有耐心。
第二，要安靜。
第三，要專注。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
What do you think about what I told you?
This task means that it needs a person who can perform a task irrespective of their own will.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
你覺得我說的怎麼樣？
這個任務意味著需要一個能不顧個人意願去執行任務的人。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
It's necessary to keep this request secret.
But it's also your duty not to tell anyone.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
必須對這個請求保密。
但這也是你的職責，不要告訴任何人。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
This is all your choice.
Will you help us with this request?
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
這完全是你的選擇。
你願意幫助我們完成這個請求嗎？

scripts.text: I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 我會做的。

scripts.text: Give me time to think.
scripts.translation: 讓我考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Ok, to Veins.
I'll contact them.
It's your first duty to go to Veins.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
好的，去伯仁斯。
我會聯絡他們。
你的第一個任務是去伯仁斯。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
You should be able to find it easily.
Go now.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
你應該能很容易找到那裡。
現在去吧。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Got it.
But don't think about it for too long.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
明白了。
但別想太久。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Hmm, you are my peer.
I'm Ahcart. I'm from Veins.
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
嗯，你是我的同行。
我是阿卡特，來自伯仁斯。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Of course, a chapter of the assassin guild is not only in Morocc. If you have a chance to go there, visit there.
I think you might go there.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
當然，刺客公會的一個分部不僅僅在莫洛可。如果有機會去那裡，就去拜訪一下。
我想你可能會去那裡。

scripts.text:
[A man of a sharp impression]
....
What the...?
You are not an assassin.
scripts.translation:
[目光銳利的男子]
....
這...？
你不是刺客。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
If you become stronger and more skillful, then the assassin's guild will give you a special task.
Go for it.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
如果你變得更強、更熟練，刺客公會就會給你一個特殊任務。
加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Have you thought about it more?
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
你想好了嗎？

scripts.text: I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 我會做的。

scripts.text: I'm not ready.
scripts.translation: 我還沒準備好

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Ok, to Veins.
I'll contact them.
It's your first duty to go to Veins.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
好的，去伯仁斯。
我會聯絡他們。
你的第一個任務是去伯仁斯。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
You should be able to find it easily.
Go now.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
你應該能很容易找到那裡。
現在去吧。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
You are too cautious.
I get the sense that you don't want to work for us.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
你太謹慎了。
我感覺你並不想為我們工作。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Go to Veins and find a chapter.
You can hear more details from there.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
去伯仁斯，找到一個分部。
在那裡你可以聽到更詳細的情報。

scripts.text:
[Ahcart]
Good luck to you.
scripts.translation:
[阿卡特]
祝你好運。

克雷夫說，有個女孩日夜不停地購買大量物品。

scripts.text:
{0}
Let me collect all the information...
scripts.translation:
{0}
讓我收集一下所有的情報...

scripts.text:
{0}
But the reason that Trovan suspects them is...
scripts.translation:
{0}
但特羅萬懷疑他們的原因是...

scripts.text: They are unfamiliar
scripts.translation: 他們很陌生

scripts.text: The residence is unclear
scripts.translation: 居住地不明

scripts.text:
{0}
No, that's not the reason. The guard sees new adventurers every day.
Besides, Madelle told me that it was a guy and Crave said it was a girl.
I'm confused.
scripts.translation:
{0}
不，那不是原因。衛兵每天都看到新的冒險者。
而且，瑪德勒告訴我那是個男人，克雷夫卻說是個女孩。
我很困惑。

scripts.text:
{0}
Let me rethink this.
scripts.translation:
{0}
讓我再想想。

scripts.text:
{0}
Yeah, adventurers often visit so it can't be a proper reason.
scripts.translation:
{0}
是啊，冒險者經常來訪，這不能算是一個合理的理由。

scripts.text:
{0}
The thing Trovan suspected is that his residence is unclear. But he shows up often and buys supplies regularly.
scripts.translation:
{0}
特羅萬懷疑的是他的居住地不明。但他經常露面，而且定期購買補給品。

scripts.text: Madelle witnessed 2...
scripts.translation: 瑪德勒看到了2個人...

scripts.text: There are more than 2...
scripts.translation: 不止2個人...

scripts.text: It could be a helper.
scripts.translation: 可能是助手。

scripts.text:
{0}
Yeah. There could be one more helper.
She sent a person to buy the stuff instead of herself.
Or it could be a peer Madelle can't see.
scripts.translation:
{0}
是啊。可能還有一個助手。
她派了個人來買東西，而不是自己來。
或者那是瑪德勒看不到的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Oh~ you're good-looking!
So, what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
哦~你長得真好看！
那麼，你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hmm, you're a girl.
Ok pick up whatever you want.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
嗯，你是女孩。
好吧，隨便拿你想要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
The room in the corner. Feel free to enter it because no one enters that room anyway.
Or do you need something?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
角落裡的房間。反正沒人進那個房間，你可以隨意進去。
或者你需要什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Oh~! good for me.
Who is she?
You told her that we'll protect her?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
哦~！真是幫了我的忙。
她是誰？
你告訴她我們會保護她嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
She is in a room.
The one in front of master's room.
Can you find it?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
她在房間裡。
就在師父房間的前面。
你能找到嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
That girl...
will be sent to her home?
Don't worry about that.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
那個女孩...
會被送回家嗎？
別擔心那個。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Oh, it's perfect timing.
Mayshell will call you.
Go to the master's room.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
哦，時機正好。
梅謝爾會叫你的。
去師父的房間。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
What do you need?
We don't sell to anyone who has started the special task.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
你需要什麼？
我們不賣給已經開始了特殊任務的人。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
You've completed the task perfectly.
What do you need now?
Do you need something else?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
你完美地完成了任務。
現在你需要什麼？
還需要別的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Oh~ you're good-looking~!
It's worthwhile to open a pub~
I can feel fruitful labors whenever I see a guy like you~
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
哦~你長得真帥~！
開這家酒館真是值得~
每次看到你這樣的帥哥，我都覺得辛苦是值得的~

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hmm... You look as good as I did in my youth.
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
嗯...你看起來和我年輕時一樣帥。
你想要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hum...you're a girl.
Ok pick up whatever you want.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
嗯...原來你是女孩啊。
好吧，隨便挑你想要的。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I'm not sure that you already know or not, but we are selling special Morocc liquor.
Which one do you want?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
不知道你是否已經知道了，但我們正在出售特殊的摩洛哥酒。
你想要哪一種？

scripts.text: Tropical Sograt
scripts.translation: 熱帶的蘇克拉特

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach
scripts.translation: 赤色海灘

scripts.text: No thanks!
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are, take it.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
給你，拿好。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's 800 zeny per glass of Tropical Sograt.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
熱帶的蘇克拉特每杯800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are, take it.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
給你，拿好。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's 800 zeny per glass of Vermilion on the Beach.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
赤色海灘每杯800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Don't show me your nervousness!
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
別在我面前表現出緊張的樣子！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
What? Why are you looking at me like that?
Oh? You are a person of this world.
Your name is...
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
什麼？你為什麼那樣看著我？
哦？你是這個世界的人。
你的名字是...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ah~ I've heard your name before.
Umm... right!
You were recommended by Ahcart.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
啊~我好像聽過你的名字。
嗯...對了！
你是阿卡特推薦來的。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
What, I don't know that name.
Hey, I have to be in business, so can you move over?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
什麼，我不認識這個名字。
喂，我得做生意，你能讓開一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Yeah, can you find an entrance to an alley in the corner?
Go in there, then you can hear a more detailed story.
Take on this special task~!
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
對，你能找到角落裡的巷子入口嗎？
進去之後，就能聽到更詳細的故事了。
接受這個特殊任務吧~！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ah, I'm not selling liquir to someone who's started the special task.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
啊，我不賣酒給已經開始特殊任務的人。

scripts.text: Not selling liquor...
scripts.translation: 不賣酒...

scripts.text: I need information.
scripts.translation: 我需要資訊。

scripts.text: Fine then punk!
scripts.translation: 好吧，朽魔！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hey, you are performing a task now.
And you want me to sell you booze?!
Is every assasin like you? Lazy boozers?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
喂，你現在正在執行任務。
還想讓我賣酒給你？！
每個刺客都像你一樣嗎？懶散的酒鬼？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
You dare to demand information after taking a task.
You didn't meet a master yet?
As if I would just tell you because you ask!
You are childish.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
你接了任務還敢要求資訊。
你還沒見過師父吧？
以為我隨便問就會告訴你嗎？
你太幼稚了。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Don't talk to me like I'm one of your friends!
You have no right to be that way!
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
別把我當成你的朋友那樣說話！
你沒有那樣做的權利！

scripts.text: Yes,I did.
scripts.translation: 是的，我做了。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hmm, I see...
Your opinion will be important.
I got it.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
嗯，我明白了...
你的意見很重要。
我知道了。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
She was so scared,
so I gave her a hot drink
and took her to a her room.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
她當時很害怕，
所以我給她倒了一杯熱飲，
並把她帶回了房間。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Well... there is better place to keep an eye on her than this room.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
嗯...沒有比這個房間更合適的地方來照看她了。

scripts.text: No, I just protect...
scripts.translation: 不，我只是在保護...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ah~ whatever anyway you make me work.
To protect that young girl.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
啊~反正你讓我幹活。
去保護那個年輕女孩吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Mayshell told me that I have to support you, so I'm not going to complain.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
梅謝爾告訴我必須支援你，所以我不會抱怨。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
So, don't worry.
Are you supposed to be here for her?
Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
所以，別擔心。
你是為了她才在這裡的嗎？
去吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Mayshell and the other guys will handle it.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
梅謝爾和其他人會處理這件事的。

scripts.text: Give me 1 glass.
scripts.translation: 給我一杯。

scripts.text: Then, can you give milk?
scripts.translation: 那，能給我牛奶嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Why? Are you disappointed?
Um~
I can't let anyone on duty drink.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
為什麼？你失望了？
嗯~
我不能讓正在值班的人喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I told you that I won't sell you any.
An empty glass is fine without liquor.
I already told you...
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
我告訴過你，我不會賣給你。
空杯子沒有酒也是空的。
我已經說過了...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
You hope that there will be something in the glass?
Information can't come out of empty glasses.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
你希望杯子裡有什麼東西？
資訊不會從空杯子裡冒出來。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
You need a glass?
Mayshell's order distracted you, so you can't understand anything.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
你需要一個杯子？
梅謝爾的指令讓你分心了，所以你什麼都聽不懂。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
You seem to be worried.
Here, It's cold water.
You think over with cold water.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
你看起來很憂心。
給你，這是冷水。
喝點冷水冷靜一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Wait in an alley where she usually shows up to find her, and you will be able to pursue the question.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
去她通常出現的那條小巷裡等著，你就能找到她並繼續追問了。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Did you solve it?
What will you do?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
你解決了嗎？
你打算怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
So, go to the east of village, you can see a narrow alley directed to the north.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
所以，去村莊的東邊，你會看到一條向北延伸的小巷。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Haha... how's it going?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
哈哈...進展如何？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I sent a girl named Estillda to her home.
Why do we handle worthless things like it?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
我派了一個叫艾絲蒂爾達的女孩去她家。
我們為什麼要處理這種毫無價值的事情？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
The field northwest of Veins.
You can find that easily with a map.
There are lots of wolves, so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
伯仁斯西北方向的田野。
用地圖很容易找到。
那裡有很多狼，所以小心點。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hey, how's Mayshell?
Can you fix an uncomfortable way of talking?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
嘿，梅謝爾怎麼樣了？
你能改掉那種讓人不舒服的說話方式嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
No. It's not funny anymore.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
不。這已經不好笑了。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I'll let you know all the information that I know.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
我會告訴你我所知道的所有資訊。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
If you need to, visit me anytime and I'll serve you a drink after your task is done.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
如果需要，隨時來找我。任務完成後，我會請你喝一杯。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ok, what do you want to know?
You hope that there will be something in the glass?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
好的，你想知道什麼？
你希望杯子裡會有什麼東西嗎？

scripts.text: Ask for help.
scripts.translation: 尋求幫助

scripts.text: Handle it by yourself.
scripts.translation: 自己處理

scripts.text:
[Daora]
So, it means just killing a strange guy in the village?
Why were you in agony because of that?
Hmm... Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
所以，意思就是隻要殺掉村裡那個奇怪的傢伙？
你之前為什麼為此如此痛苦？
嗯...讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Then it will need legwork?
Where is the most crowded place in this village?
The pub and motel.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
那需要跑腿調查？
這個村子裡最熱鬧的地方是哪裡？
酒館和旅館。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
And the guard of the village always keeps an eye on strange people.
Or the old merchant is quick in visual learning.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
而且村裡的衛兵總是盯著陌生人。
或者那個老商人觀察力很敏銳。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I can say that especially...
Trovan, Crave who is a trader, and Madelle in the pub are quick in visual learning.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
我可以特別指出...
特羅萬、商人克雷夫，還有酒館裡的瑪德勒，他們的觀察力都很敏銳。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's good information, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
這是很好的資訊，不是嗎？

scripts.text: - The advice of Daora is attached to the board with quest information. -
scripts.translation: - 達奧拉的建議已貼在任務資訊板上。 -

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ok. It's great.
Each word and behavior will be an important key of the events.
So, look around carefully and figure it out.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
好的。太棒了。
每一句話和每一個行為都將是事件的關鍵。
所以，仔細看看周圍，弄清楚情況。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Something good will happen.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
會有好事發生的。

scripts.text: Figure out based on information.
scripts.translation: 根據資訊推斷

scripts.text: Stop the stage.
scripts.translation: 停止調查

scripts.text: You stop the confirmation of information.
scripts.translation: 你停止了資訊的確認。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Trying wouldn't hurt.
If you want to find a root, you have to find a leaf first.
Work hard.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
試一試也無妨。
若想找到根，就得先找到葉。
努力吧。

scripts.text: Get advice.
scripts.translation: 尋求建議

scripts.text: It's a secret.
scripts.translation: 這是秘密

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Can you let me know about an information you collected?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
能告訴我你收集到的資訊嗎？

scripts.text: You have a heart-to-heart talk with him.
scripts.translation: 與他推心置腹地交談

scripts.text: That's impossible.
scripts.translation: 那是不可能的

scripts.text:
[Daora]
What, I can't support you properly?
You solve it by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
什麼，我不能好好支援你嗎？
那就自己解決吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Hum. Got it.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
嗯。明白了。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
There is a guy who looks like a priest and Trovan and Madelle saw him.
A merchant saw a girl who buys things regularly.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
有個看起來像牧師的男人，特羅萬和瑪德勒都見過他。
有個商人見過一個經常來買東西的女孩。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
The main target is a guy,
but the helper is a girl.
Maybe.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
主要目標是個男人，
但助手是個女孩。
大概是吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Above all,
it's really getting to you.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
最重要的是，
這件事真的讓你很困擾。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Then it's simple.
Why don't you meet her in the place where she visits often?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
那就簡單了。
為什麼不去她常去的地方見她呢？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's the transience of duty.
You don't know the meaning with a piece of the puzzle.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
這是職責的無常。
僅憑拼圖的一角，你無法理解其含義。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
They can be related people or not.
Ok, I'll be very attentive to my want.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
他們可能是相關的人，也可能不是。
好吧，我會非常留意我的願望。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Right~?
Go on a place where can look down a village well and find Melissa.
That will be helpful.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
對吧~？
去一個能俯瞰村莊的地方，找到梅麗莎。
那會有幫助的。

scripts.text: - Daora's advice is attached on the board of quest. -
scripts.translation: - 達奧拉的建議已附在任務板上。 -

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Umm~.
Right. There is a secret
you can't tell anyone while perfoming a task.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
嗯~。
沒錯。在執行任務時，
有一個不能告訴任何人的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
In those regards, you surpass the standards.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
在這方面，你超越了標準。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
The blind alley that Melissa told means this street.
You are thinking like a child.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
梅麗莎所說的死衚衕指的是這條街。
你像個孩子一樣思考。

scripts.text: Where is the blind alley?
scripts.translation: 死衚衕在哪裡？

scripts.text: It's okay.
scripts.translation: 沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
The blind alley?
Hmm... well.
Is there a blind alley like our pub...
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
死衚衕？
嗯...好吧。
是指像我們酒館那樣的死衚衕嗎...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ah, in the northeast alley
directed upside in the village,
there is no street because
the houses stand close together in that area.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
啊，在村莊東北方向的那條巷子裡，
因為那裡的房子建得很密集，
所以沒有街道。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Around Melissa's house,
that is the blind alley
for the boy, maybe.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
在梅麗莎家附近，
那大概就是那個男孩所說的死衚衕吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's very easy to find walking around the village.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
在村裡四處走走，很容易就能找到。

scripts.text: - Daora's advice is attached on the board of quest. -
scripts.translation: - 達奧拉的建議已附在任務板上。 -

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ok. It's going well.
Can I expect a good result?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
好的，進展順利。
我能期待一個好的結果嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I'm not sure if he still lives...
Anyway, he is a key artisan in Rachel,
and can recognize all kinds of keys.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
我不確定他是否還住在那裡...
總之，他是拉赫的關鍵工匠，
能識別各種各樣的鑰匙。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
What? Residence?
I told you, it's Rachel.
He maybe lives in comfort for the rest of his days in Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
什麼？住所？
我告訴過你，是拉赫。
他可能在拉赫安度餘生。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Go ask inside a pub of Rachel...
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
去拉赫的酒館裡面問問吧...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Yeah, how's it going?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
嗯，進展如何？

scripts.text: It progress satisfactorily.
scripts.translation: 進展順利。

scripts.text: Show the key.
scripts.translation: 出示鑰匙。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
My glass, you don't need it?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
我的酒杯，你不需要嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I already have enough information.
If that is a stuff has a long story behind it,
we have only one way.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我已經掌握了足夠的資訊。
如果那是一件有著漫長故事的東西，
我們只有一條路可走。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Right.
If you think carefully,
you can find a way.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
沒錯。
如果你仔細思考，
就能找到辦法。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Daora]
What is th--
I see, that guy had this key...?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
這是什...
我明白了，那個傢伙拿著這把鑰匙...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's a symbol of shrines
and has a showy pattern.
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
這是神龕的象徵，
有著華麗的圖案。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Daora]
So, you want to know this key's use?
If you do, go to Rachel.
There is a key artisan there.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
所以，你想知道這把鑰匙的用途？
如果是的話，去拉赫吧。
那裡有一位鑰匙工匠。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Now, he is retired, but he
spends his declining years in peace.
You can ask him yourself.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
現在他已退休，
正在那裡安度晚年。
你可以親自去問他。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ask what this key's use is.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
詢問這把鑰匙的用途。

scripts.text: - Daora's advice is attached on the quest board. -
scripts.translation: - 達奧拉的建議貼在任務板上。 -

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Don't pretend to be a noblewoman.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
別裝成什麼貴族小姐了。

scripts.text: I'm going to go.
scripts.translation: 我要走了。

scripts.text: Do you know a mansion around Veins?
scripts.translation: 你知道伯仁斯附近有什麼豪宅嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ok.
Don't be carried away by ill-advised bravery.
Well... it's also hard to be killed.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
好的。
別一時衝動，魯莽行事。
嗯...不過想死也不容易。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Yes, sure.
There is a mansion between ravines.
It's very gloomy.
I don't understand his taste.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
是的，當然知道。
在峽谷之間有一座豪宅。
那裡非常陰森。
我不懂他的品味。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
And that mansion is built in back of a ravine...
It's always dark like the night.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
而且那座豪宅建在峽谷後面...
那裡總是像夜晚一樣黑暗。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
The location?
Well...
It's in the northwest field of Veins.
You can go through a narrow road to northeast.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
位置嗎？
嗯...
在伯仁斯西北方的田野裡。
你可以沿著一條小路往東北方向走。

scripts.text: - Daora's advice is attached on the board of quest. -
scripts.translation: - 達奧拉的建議已附在任務板上。 -

scripts.text:
[Daora]
There are lots of scary wolves in that area, be careful.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
那個區域有很多可怕的狼，小心點。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Our milk is expensive!
Give me 500 zeny for a cup.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
我們的牛奶很貴的！
一杯要500 Zeny。

scripts.text: It's ok. Give me a cup of milk.
scripts.translation: 好吧，給我來一杯牛奶。

scripts.text: You are a barefaced robber!
scripts.translation: 你這強盜！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are. Milk.
Then take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
給你。牛奶。
那就休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I told you, it's 500 zeny.
A poor man. You have only a fine figure!
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
我說了，是500 Zeny。
真窮。除了長得好看，你還有什麼？

scripts.text:
[Daora]
An impertinent fellow!
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
無禮的傢伙！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
If you decide on a way to walk, it's time to start newly.
Everyone is waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
既然決定了要走的路，就該重新出發了。
大家都在等你。

scripts.text: Tropical Sograt
scripts.translation: 熱帶的蘇克拉特

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach
scripts.translation: 赤色海灘

scripts.text: Milk
scripts.translation: 牛奶

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are, take it.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
給你，拿好。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's 800 zeny per 1 glass of Tropical Sograt.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
熱帶的蘇克拉特一杯800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are, take it.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
給你，拿好。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
[Daora]
It's 800 zeny per 1 glass of Vermilion on the Beach.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
赤色海灘一杯800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Uh... Umm...
It's complicated order. but I don't have any choice since you want it.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
呃...嗯...
這個訂單有點複雜。但既然您想要，我也別無選擇。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Ah, milk.
Huu! Milk!
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
啊，牛奶。
呼！牛奶！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I feel sorry to take 500 zeny per bottle, but I have to.
It's very hard to get milk in Veins.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
一瓶收500 Zeny，雖然我覺得有點抱歉，但我必須這麼做。
在伯仁斯，牛奶非常難弄到。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Umm... I think I can't help you.
There is no milk in Veins.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
嗯...我想我幫不了您。
伯仁斯沒有牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I don't have anything like that.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
我沒有那種東西。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
I'm not sure that you already know or not, but we are selling special liquor of Morocc.
Which one do you want?
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
我不確定您是否已經知道，但我們正在出售摩洛哥的特製烈酒。
您想要哪一種？

scripts.text: Tropical Sograt
scripts.translation: 熱帶的蘇克拉特

scripts.text: Vermilion the beach
scripts.translation: 赤色海灘

scripts.text: No thanks!
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are, take it.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
給你，拿好。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's 1000 zeny per glass of Tropical Sograt.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
熱帶的蘇克拉特一杯1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Here you are, take it.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
給你，拿好。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
It's 1000 zeny per glass of Vermilion on the Beach.
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
赤色海灘一杯1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Daora]
Don't show me your nervousness!
scripts.translation:
[達奧拉]
別在我面前表現出緊張的樣子！

scripts.text: - You can't continue this quest because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You were sent here by Ahcart?
I'll give you a task without asking anymore questions.
Ok, listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
您是阿卡特派您來的？
我不再多問，直接給您一個任務。
好，仔細聽。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You already have your orders.
Even though you don't have any evidence, I trust you to do a good job.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
您已經收到指令了。
雖然您沒有任何證據，但我相信您能做好這份工作。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Welcome.
How was your day?
I heard about your activity.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
歡迎。
您今天過得怎麼樣？
我聽說您的行為了。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Ok, you have something to do?
If you are late, Renzak might get upset.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
好的，您有事要做嗎？
如果您遲到了，倫扎克可能會不高興。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I already got a report from Renzak.
I'm so happy to see you.
But quickness is very important to us.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
我已經收到倫扎克的報告了。
很高興見到您。
但速度對我們來說非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I already got a report from Renzak.
You completed the task quickly.
That's great.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
我已經收到倫扎克的報告了。
您很快完成了任務。
這很好。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You are acknowledged by the guild.
Feel free to come whenever you want to become a Guillotine Cross.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
您已被公會認可。
如果您想成為十字斬首者，隨時歡迎前來。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Even though I gave you a qualification,
I don't want to celebrate that qualification.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
雖然我給了您資格，
但我並不想慶祝這個資格。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You are not allowed in here.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
您不允許進入這裡。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
We are chasing a person trying to dissolve an organization.
We got information about a guy who looks like a town leader.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
我們正在追捕一個試圖解散組織的人。
我們得到情報，說有一個看起來像城鎮首領的傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Your task is to punish him under the cover of shadow.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你的任務是在陰影中懲罰他。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Our objective shouldn't be released to anybody.
Your memories should disappear in shadow.
Be cautious and avoid observation.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
我們的目標絕不能洩露給任何人。
你的記憶應消失在陰影中。
保持警惕，避免被監視。

scripts.text: Ok...
scripts.translation: 好的...

scripts.text: So the task is...?
scripts.translation: 那麼任務是...

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
What does he look like?
How do you recognize him?
I can't tell you.
That's for you to find out.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
他長什麼樣？
你怎麼認出他？
我無法告訴你。
那是你需要自己發現的。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You will need a compass.
You need a lamp and a light to see in the darkness.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你需要一個指南針。
你需要一盞燈和光源，以便在黑暗中看清。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
At that point, you will be able to have a drink and rest.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
到那時，你就可以喝點東西休息一下了。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Overcome the adversity.
It is up to you to judge.
We can't help you, so you must figure it out for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
克服逆境。
由你來判斷。
我們無法幫助你，所以你必須自己想辦法。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
We saw a stranger in this village, we are quite sure that he is the person who we are looking for your task.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
我們在這個村莊看到了一個陌生人，我們相當確定他就是我們要找的人，也就是你的任務目標。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
{0}.
Time is not waiting for you.
Go ahead. Spill blood with the blade of a knife that stands for a stoic life.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
{0}。
時間不會等你。
去吧。用象徵堅忍生命的刀刃，濺出鮮血。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
It's a test to watch you.
Let me see, {0}...
Go out and think about what you have to do first.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
這是一場觀察你的考驗。
讓我看看，{0}...
先出去想想你要做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Your task is finding a stranger.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你的任務是尋找一個陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Go out search diligently.
I'll allow you to have some water.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
出去仔細搜尋。
我允許你喝點水。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Meet Daora before you start.
She may be helpful to you.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
開始之前先見見達奧拉。
她可能會對你有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You found a key, right?
Huhu. I have my ways of finding out.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你找到鑰匙了，對吧？
呵呵。我有我的辦法。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Can you show me the key?
I'm going to check if
you were capable or not...
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你能把鑰匙給我看看嗎？
我要檢查一下
你是否具備能力...

scripts.text: Give a key to him.
scripts.translation: 把鑰匙給他

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You didn't bring a key?
I'll be in lots of trouble.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你沒帶鑰匙？
這會讓我陷入大麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I didn't expect your success without a clear target...
You are a man of greater ability than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
沒想到你在沒有明確目標的情況下成功了...
你比我想像的更有能力。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I think you find a target what we look for.
Then you handle it after finding a key's host.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
我想你找到了我們要找的目標。
那麼，在找到鑰匙的主人之後，由你來處理他。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
Then it'll be over.
But you have to find the key's host by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
那麼，一切就結束了。
但你要自己找到鑰匙的主人。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
When you find the mansion, there will be a person waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
當你找到那座宅邸時，會有人在那裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
This is the last step.
Don't make any mistakes.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
這是最後一步。
千萬不要出錯。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You were not punctual...
At least you came back alive.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你不夠準時...
至少你還活著回來了。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You did the job by yourself
even though there wasn't any
information about it, and you
collected it.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
儘管沒有任何情報，
你還是獨自完成了任務，
並收集到了它。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You made full use of Daora's advice.
But, didn't I mention it?
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你充分利用了達奧拉的建議。
但我不是提過嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You corresponded with all conditions
promptly and with patience.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你迅速且耐心地
滿足了所有條件。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
The evaluation of your task is... [S].
[S] is for 'special'.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你的任務評價是... [S]。
[S]代表“特別”。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
The evaluation of your task is... [A].
If you were punctual, you would have received higher.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你的任務評價是... [A]。
如果你能準時，評價會更高。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I told you to keep it a secret...
Of course, I don't want to blame you.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
我告訴過你要保守秘密...
當然，我不想責怪你。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
It's important not only to solve this by yourself,
but also to make an effort getting information.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
重要的是，不僅要獨自解決這件事，
還要努力獲取情報。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
The evaluation of your task is... [B].
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你的任務評價是... [B]。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
The evaluation of your task is... [C].
You need to act by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你的任務評價是... [C]。
你需要獨立行動。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You adjusted an affair with flexible points of view.
You were not dependent on the others and you used the surroundings properly.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
你以靈活的視角處理了事務。
你沒有依賴他人，
併合理利用了周圍環境。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I like that.
The evaluation of your task is... [A].
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
我喜歡這樣。
你的任務評價是... [A]。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I like that.
The evaluation of your task is... [B].
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
我喜歡這樣。
你的任務評價是... [B]。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
You got a new qualification for completing this task.
It's a shadow of our assasin as a shadow of the world...
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
完成此任務後，你獲得了一項新資格。
它是世界陰影中，
我們刺客的陰影...

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I'm going to give you the qualification to be a ^4d4dffGuillotine Cross^000000.
I'm not pushing you, so you can come whenever you want to visit.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
我將授予你成為^4d4dff十字斬首者^000000的資格。
我不強迫你，你想什麼時候來都可以。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I reward you for your labor, and I'm going to give you a present.
I got this one from guild, I hope it's helpful to you.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
為了獎勵你的辛勞，
我要送你一份禮物。
這是我從公會拿來的，
希望對你有用。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]
I want to tell you something.
I order you that ^4d4dffyou should not leave a document at all^000000, whatever it is.
scripts.translation:
[梅謝爾]
我有件事想告訴你。
我命令你^4d4dff絕對不要留下任何檔案^000000，無論是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Mayshell]

scripts.translation:
[克雷夫]
我覺得她是離家出走了。
她每天早晚都會定期來這裡買東西。

scripts.text:
[Crave]
She may run away when she sees you.
It's probably better to hide in the alley to catch her.
scripts.translation:
[克雷夫]
她看到你可能會逃跑。
最好躲在巷子裡埋伏她。

Why do you change your face while I'm talking about a steady customer?
Oh, you are...
It's a sword of darkness that can't make a profit unrelated to memorizing people's faces.
scripts.translation:
[年輕商人]
為什麼我在談論穩定顧客時，你的表情變了？
哦，你是...
這是一把無法帶來利潤的黑暗之劍，與記住人們的臉無關。

scripts.text:
[Crave]
Excuse me?
Did you find who you were looking for?
scripts.translation:
[克雷夫]
打擾一下？
你找到你要找的人了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Do you have any inconveniences while you are traveling?
At the outskirts of the city, there are many monsters. Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
你在旅途中有什麼不便嗎？
在城外有很多魔物。請小心。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
I already gave you all the information I have.
He's the only suspicious person that's been seen.
But nothing has happened yet, so I'm keeping watch.
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
我已經把我知道的所有情報都給你了。
他是唯一被目擊到的可疑人物。
但還沒發生什麼事，所以我正在監視他。

Hello?
Do you need help?
scripts.translation:
[義警]
你好？
需要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text: Do you know Trovan?
scripts.translation: 你認識特羅萬嗎？

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Eh? I'm Trovan, a member of the vigilante corps of Veins.
What's the matter?
scripts.translation:
[義警]
咦？我就是特羅萬，伯仁斯義警團的一員。
怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Ah, you were recommended by Daora.
I remember all of the faces of people who live in this village.
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
啊，原來是達奧拉推薦你來的。
我記住了住在這個村莊的所有人的臉。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Maybe he is a stranger.
We should exclude normal adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
也許他是外鄉人。
我們應該排除普通的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
And if Daora finds a person, he must not be a normal person.
So we should exclude normal guests...
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
而且如果達奧拉發現了一個人，那肯定不是普通人。
所以我們應該排除普通的客人...

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Then we can set limits for guessing who it is.
A few days ago, a priest visited this village.
He covered his face with a hood, so I couldn't see him too well.
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
這樣我們就能縮小猜測的範圍了。
幾天前，有一位牧師來過這個村莊。
他用兜帽遮住了臉，所以我沒看清他的長相。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
I can detect suspicious people pretty well.
He might be a criminal if he were hiding his face.
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
我挺擅長髮現可疑人物的。
如果他遮住臉，可能就是個罪犯。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Why is he suspicious?
He shows up here regularly, but he has no definite residence.
And I always lose him when I try to follow him.
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
他為什麼可疑？
他經常來這裡，但沒有固定的住所。
而且每次我想跟蹤他，都會跟丟。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
I can't offer any more information.
I always have to guard the entrance of the village, so I can't follow him for too long.
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
我沒法提供更多情報了。
我必須一直看守村莊入口，所以沒法長時間跟蹤他。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Anyway. He is a only person who I suspect.
He hasn't been caught doing anything criminal,
but he's always covering himself up.
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
總之。他是唯一讓我懷疑的人。
雖然沒抓到他做什麼壞事，
但他總是把自己遮得嚴嚴實實的。

Recently, I've seen many suspicious people.
I'm keeping strict watch.
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
最近，我見過很多可疑的人。
我正在嚴密監視。

我已經把我知道的所有情報都給你了。
他是唯一被目擊到的可疑人物。
但還沒發生什麼事，所以我正在監視他。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
I'm Trovan, a guard of Veins.
What's wrong?
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
我是特羅萬，伯仁斯的衛兵。
怎麼了？

scripts.text: Is there a wanted man?
scripts.translation: 有通緝犯嗎？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
A wanted man?
No, what's the matter?
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
通緝犯？
沒有啊，怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Did you find any suspicious people entering this village lately?
Umm...
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
你最近發現有什麼可疑的人進入這個村莊嗎？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Recently, there's been a man in this village wearing a hood.
He is not a traveler. He bought food and slipped out of the village.
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
最近村裡來了個戴兜帽的男人。
他不是旅行者，買了些食物後就悄悄離開了村莊。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
I'm wondering about his identity.
I think he is related to a shrine...
Or maybe he isn't...
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
我在琢磨他的身份。
我覺得他和神龕有點關係...
也許不是吧...

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
There is no one else like him among the people living in this village.
I wonder where he is from.
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
村裡沒有和他長得像的人。
不知道他是從哪裡來的。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
He might still be here.
There are no new people except for him. I know almost all of the adventurer's faces that visit here.
So that's not much news.
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
他可能還在附近。
除了他，沒有新面孔。我幾乎認識所有來這裡的冒險者。
所以這不算什麼大新聞。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
Don't go too far away.
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
別走太遠。

scripts.text:
[Trovan]
How's it going?
scripts.translation:
[特羅萬]
最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
What a huge sandstorm.
Are you ok?
scripts.translation:
[貨郎]
好大的沙塵暴啊。
你沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
So, did you find that girl?
If you do, let her know that she has to come and visit me.
scripts.translation:
[貨郎]
那麼，你找到那個女孩了嗎？
如果找到了，告訴她一定要來找我。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
Hey. Hey!
I'm talking to you!
scripts.translation:
[貨郎]
嘿。嘿！
我在跟你說話呢！

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
Did you send my message properly?
Then why she hasn't she visited here to exchange the fish?
scripts.translation:
[貨郎]
你好好把我的話傳給她了嗎？
那她為什麼還沒來換魚？

scripts.text: - You can't get more information from the peddler. What information have I collected? -

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text: Listen to the story.
scripts.translation: 聽故事

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
You are too cold.
scripts.translation:
[貨郎]
你太冷淡了。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
A pretty girl just bought food.
You know that freshness is important when buying fish...
scripts.translation:
[貨郎]
剛才有個漂亮女孩買了食物。
你知道買魚最重要的是新鮮...

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
But I gave the wrong fish to her.
Recently, she bought food from my store.
I can't find her, maybe she doesn't live here.
scripts.translation:
[貨郎]
但我給她拿錯了魚。
最近她一直在我的店裡買東西。
我找不到她，也許她不住在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
She looks shabby but she always buys expensive food.
I thought that she was a maid but we don't have a mansion that can hire maids in Veins.
scripts.translation:
[貨郎]
她看起來有點寒酸，但總是買很貴的食物。
我以為她是女僕，但伯仁斯沒有能僱得起女僕的豪宅。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
Kind of suspicious, isn't it?
But, I gave spoiled fish to her...
scripts.translation:
[貨郎]
有點可疑，不是嗎？
但是，我給了她變質的魚...

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
So I have to find her and exchange the fish for a refund.
scripts.translation:
[貨郎]
所以我必須找到她，把魚換掉並退款。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
If you find her, send that message, please?
I can't miss a guest like her.
scripts.translation:
[貨郎]
如果你找到她，請幫我傳個話好嗎？
我可不想錯過像她這樣的客人。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
Ok, let's see...
She is blonde girl.
You should be able
to find her easily.
scripts.translation:
[貨郎]
好的，讓我想想...
她是個金髮女孩。
你應該很容易就能找到她。

scripts.text:
[Peddler]
Actually, nobody knows where she's from.
You're an adventurer, so I'm asking you.
scripts.translation:
[貨郎]
其實，沒人知道她是從哪裡來的。
你是冒險者，所以我想問問你。

scripts.text: I'll send her your message.
scripts.translation: 我會把你的話轉告給她。

scripts.text: Hmm...

那麼，請幫我轉告她。
如果換不了魚，它們就會變質的。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Haha... I can remember my past when I see a young adventurer like you...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哈哈...看到你這樣的年輕冒險者，讓我想起了我的過去...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Thanks for talking to me.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
謝謝你跟我說話。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What? What's the matter?
You want to talk with me?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什麼？怎麼了？
你想跟我說話？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
You want to know something?
We have a marvelous girl in our village.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你想知道什麼？
我們村裡有個很棒的女孩。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I still don't know.
I'm too old...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我還不清楚。
我太老了...

scripts.text: - I can't get anymore information from the Old Man. What information have I collected? -
scripts.translation: - 我沒法從老人那裡得到更多資訊了。我收集到了什麼資訊？ -

scripts.translation: 檢視資訊

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: You stop the confirmation of information.
scripts.translation: 你停止了資訊的確認。

scripts.text: Suspicious person...
scripts.translation: 可疑的人...

scripts.text: You look good.
scripts.translation: 你看起來不錯。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
A suspicious person?
Well, Trovan may know more about her than me.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
可疑的人？
嗯，特羅萬可能比我更瞭解她。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Thanks anyway.
I'll just sit down here...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
還是謝謝你了。
我就坐在這裡吧...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I look around at people who pass by here all the time.
I can find out where they're from easily by watching what they wear.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我一直看著從這裡經過的人。
通過看他們的穿著，我很容易就能知道他們來自哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I can't forget her at all because of her funny outfit.
It's not difficult to forget a person wearing a formal dress.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
因為她的穿著很滑稽，我完全忘不了她。
穿著正式禮服的人很難讓人忘記。

scripts.text: Then what's funny?
scripts.translation: 那哪裡滑稽？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Umm, this village is not funny anymore.
I know everything~ I even found out everyone's job.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯，這個村莊一點也不滑稽。
我什麼都知道~ 我甚至查清了每個人的職業。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
But...
Recently, a girl showed up.
In the morning, she buys some food from a peddler and then disappears.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
但是...
最近出現了一個女孩。
早上，她從貨郎那裡買些食物，然後就消失了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
And in the afternoon she usually buys the necessities of life.
A little bit at a time.
And then she goes somewhere after...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
下午她通常會買些生活必需品。
每次只買一點點。
然後她就去了某個地方...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I figure that she must be preparing something.
If she buys a lot of stuff, then she can be found easily.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我覺得她一定是在準備什麼東西。
如果她買很多東西，那就很容易找到她了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I think she stocks up heavily on foods that help during battles.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我想她大量囤積了在戰鬥中有幫助的食物。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
She just recently started this routine.
Is she a newcomer?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
她最近才開始這種習慣。
她是新來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I'm going to watch you for a while.
Ah, why am I bothering you with this story?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我要盯著你看一會兒。
啊，我為什麼要拿這個故事煩你呢？

scripts.translation:
[老人]
我不知道她有什麼天賦，但她很會找人。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
If you want to find her, ask that kid.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
如果你想找她，去問那個小孩。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Hi?
What?
Have you lost a friend?
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
嗨？
什麼？
你丟了朋友？

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Did you find her?
Say thanks to her for giving me candy the other day.
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
你找到她了嗎？
替我謝謝她前幾天給我的糖果。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
When I'm looking for people, an angel wearing black clothes gives me information.
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
當我找人時，一個穿黑衣服的天使會給我提供資訊。

scripts.text: Do you know something?
scripts.translation: 你知道些什麼？

scripts.text: No...
scripts.translation: 沒有...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
I have a special gift that I've had my whole life.
People visit me when they need to find something.
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
我有一種與生俱來的特殊天賦。
人們需要找東西時會來找我。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Are looking for someone?
Can you tell me about their character?
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
你在找人嗎？
能告訴我他們的性格嗎？

scripts.text: You are joking.
scripts.translation: 你在開玩笑。

scripts.text: Let me do it.
scripts.translation: 讓我去做。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Ha! But you'll come back to me when you need to find someone.
I know everything.
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
哈！但當你需要找人時，你會回到我這裡的。
我什麼都知道。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Ok, answer my question.
Is it a boy or a girl?
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
好，回答我的問題。
是男孩還是女孩？

scripts.text: A boy
scripts.translation: 男孩

scripts.text: A girl
scripts.translation: 女孩

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
A boy and...
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
男孩，還有...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
A girl and...
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
女孩，還有...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
What is the hair color?
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
髮色是什麼？

scripts.text: Dark
scripts.translation: 深色

scripts.text: Red
scripts.translation: 紅色

scripts.text: Light yellowish
scripts.translation: 淺黃色

scripts.text: White
scripts.translation: 白色

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Dark hair color... hmm...
Dark brown or black hair...
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
深色頭髮...嗯...
深棕色或黑色頭髮...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Light brown or dark orange... Red hair...
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
淺棕色或深橙色...紅髮...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Light orange to blonde hair.
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
淺橙色到金色頭髮。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Gray... white... gold... silver hair...
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
灰色...白色...金色...銀色頭髮...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Young or old?
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
年輕還是年老？

scripts.text: Like a child.
scripts.translation: 像孩子一樣

scripts.text: Young.
scripts.translation: 年輕

scripts.text: Middle-aged.
scripts.translation: 中年

scripts.text: Very old.
scripts.translation: 非常老

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
And a child.
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
是個孩子。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
A young person.
Like you?
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
年輕人。
像你一樣？

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Same age as a tool salesman?
Middle-aged.
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
和工具銷售員一樣的年紀？
中年。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Yes, very old.
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
是的，非常老。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Hi, {0}~ Let me collect all of the information you've provided...
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
你好，{0}~ 讓我整理一下你提供的資訊...

scripts.text: - She begins to murmur and gestures toward the sky. Her hair springs up as she says... -
scripts.translation: - 她開始低聲呢喃，並指向天空。她的頭髮突然豎了起來，說道... -

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Got it!
I know her.
Her name is ^4d4dffEstillda^000000.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
明白了！
我認識她。
她的名字是^4d4dff艾絲蒂爾達^000000。
對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Why are you looking for her? Is she your friend?
She gave me candy the other day.
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
你為什麼要找她？她是你的朋友嗎？
前幾天她還給我糖果了呢。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Umm... this girl...
will pass around
a blind alley in
about 1 hour!
Hehehe!
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
嗯...這個女孩...
大概1小時後
會經過那條
死衚衕！
嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
She has to be who you're looking for. I'm never wrong.
Tell me I did a good job!
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
她肯定就是你要找的人。我從不會錯的。
快誇我做得好！

scripts.text: Pat Melissa on the head.
scripts.translation: 摸摸梅麗莎的頭

scripts.text: Giver her a thumbs up sign.
scripts.translation: 給她豎個大拇指

scripts.text:
You pat Melissa on the head.
She reacts like a puppy would.
scripts.translation:
你摸了摸梅麗莎的頭。
她像小狗一樣做出了反應。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Hehehe...
I'm here to help~!
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
嘿嘿嘿...
我來幫忙啦~！

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Hehehe...
I did good!
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
嘿嘿嘿...
我做得很好吧！

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Umm...
That person who has those characteristics is...
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
嗯...
那個符合這些特徵的人是...

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Wha-...? Eww, I've never been wrong.
I don't know why, but I can't see that person.
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
什...？哎呀，我從不會錯的。
不知道為什麼，我看不到那個人。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
Eeeahhh! Wahhh!
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
嗚嗚嗚！哇哇哇！

scripts.text: - All I can do is soothe Melissa as she cries. I have to think about the person's characteristics again. -
scripts.translation: - 我只能安慰哭泣的梅麗莎。我得重新想想那個人的特徵。 -

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
It's strange.
In this village people are always looking for someone.
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
真奇怪。
在這個村莊，人們總是在尋找某個人。

scripts.text:
[Melissa]
I told Daora about this story, then she said to me not to do it again.
Maybe she isn't a good angel.
scripts.translation:
[梅麗莎]
我把這件事告訴了達奧拉，然後她讓我不要再這樣做了。
也許她不是一個好天使。

scripts.text:
.....?
There's a sign of somebody present.
You still have time.
scripts.translation:
.....？
那裡有人的氣息。
你還有時間。

scripts.text: The blind alley that Melissa told me about must be this street.
scripts.translation: 梅麗莎告訴我的那條死衚衕，應該就是這條街。

scripts.text:
There's a sign of somebody present.
A blonde girl shows up!
scripts.translation:
那裡有人的氣息。
一個金髮女孩出現了！

scripts.text: Make a surprise attack.
scripts.translation: 發動突襲

scripts.text:
You take her by the wrist trying not to let her see you.
The food that she is holding falls on the floor.
scripts.translation:
你抓住她的手腕，儘量不讓她看見你。
她手中的食物掉在了地上。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Ahhhh!
Who are you?
What are you doing?
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
啊！
你是誰？
你在幹什麼？

scripts.text: Who sent you?
scripts.translation: 誰派你來的？

scripts.text: Who's from Rachel?
scripts.translation: 你是拉赫的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I don't know! I don't have any idea. I don't know him!
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
我不知道！我完全不知道。我不認識他！

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
If I buy stuff for him...
He said that he can pay for my labor and production costs.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
如果我給他買這些東西...
他說他會支付我的勞動費和材料費。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I don't know who he is.
It's true.
Is he bad guy?
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
我真的不知道他是誰。
這是真的。
他是壞人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Help me, please?
Help me.
I'll do anything you want.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
求求你幫幫我？
幫幫我。
你讓我做什麼我都願意。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I didn't know anything about him, I don't know if he's a bad guy.
I just bought some stuff... (sobbing)...
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
我對他一無所知，我不知道他是不是壞人。
我只是買了點東西...（哭泣）...

scripts.text: - Estillda is in shock because she thinks that she's in trouble. -
scripts.translation: - 艾絲蒂爾達處於震驚狀態，因為她覺得自己要惹上麻煩了。 -

scripts.text: Calm her down.
scripts.translation: 安撫她

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Just relax for a second.
I totally understand what you're saying.
You won't get into any trouble.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
先冷靜一下。
我完全理解你的處境。
你不會惹上麻煩的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm looking for a guy who committed a crime and ran away.
I have to catch him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在追捕一個犯了罪後逃跑的傢伙。
我必須抓住他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So who made you get those supplies?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼，是誰讓你去買那些物資的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you cooperate with me, I'm going to protect you until this is all done.
The Assassin Guild will protect you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你配合我，我會保護你直到事情結束。
刺客公會會保護你。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
You promise, right?
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
你保證嗎？
我該怎麼幫你？

scripts.text: When are you supposed to meet?
scripts.translation: 你們約好什麼時候見面？

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Oh, I already delivered the stuff.
I'm on my way back.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
哦，我已經把東西送過去了。
我正在回來的路上。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Ah, these are mine.
I got a lot of zeny.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
啊，這些是我的。
我賺了很多Zeny。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then go straight this way and pretend that nothing happened.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那就沿著這條路直走，假裝什麼都沒發生。

scripts.text: - I demand that she walks as usual and tell her how to get to Daora's pub. -
scripts.translation: - 我要求她像往常一樣走路，並告訴她怎麼去達奧拉的酒館。 -

scripts.text: - The pub in the underground of Veins is the best place to keep her safe. -
scripts.translation: - 伯仁斯地下的酒館是保護她最安全的地方。 -

scripts.text: - I tried to take her by the wrist, but she already knew and ran away screaming. -
scripts.translation: - 我試圖抓住她的手腕，但她早有防備，尖叫著逃跑了。 -

scripts.text: You couldn't catch Estillda.
scripts.translation: 你沒能抓住艾絲蒂爾達。

scripts.text:
An error has occurred.
Please contact the GM team to fix this situation.
scripts.translation:
發生了一個錯誤。
請聯絡GM團隊解決此問題。

scripts.text: Estillda is looking around with an anxious expression on her face.
scripts.translation: 艾絲蒂爾達神情焦慮地四處張望。

scripts.text: Are you ok?
scripts.translation: 你還好嗎？

scripts.text: Intimidate her.
scripts.translation: 抄襲她

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Yes? Yes...
I thought assassins were scary.
But I don't think so...
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
是...是的...
我以為刺客很可怕。
但我覺得...好像也不是...

scripts.text: You don't look like you're from Veins
scripts.translation: 你看起來不像伯仁斯人

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Yes? Yes...
I'm from Rachel.
I'm here to make zeny.
I had a desolate life in Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
是...是的...
我來自拉赫。
我來這裡是為了賺Zeny。
我在拉赫過著悽慘的生活。

scripts.text: You came here with alone?
scripts.translation: 你是一個人來的嗎？

scripts.text: Had a desolate life...
scripts.translation: 悽慘的生活...

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
No.
I don't think so.
I came here with a guy.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
不。
我不這麼認為。
我是和一個男人一起來的。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I usually come here by myself. Sometimes he checks my destination.
I thought that he is an important person from some company.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
我通常都是一個人來。有時候他會確認我的目的地。
我以為他是某家公司的要人。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
But I don't know who he is.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
但我不知道他是誰。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I'm a native,
I work in his house.
I think it's not bad.
I just left my home...
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
我是本地人，
在他家裡工作。
我覺得還不錯。
我只是離開了家...

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
He said that he needed a maid and that he could pay me enough money.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
他說他需要一名女僕，而且能給我足夠的錢。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Actually I don't know him well.
...I'll never do it.
I want to go home. I miss my mommy.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
其實我並不瞭解他。
...我絕不會那樣做。
我想回家。我想媽媽了。

scripts.text: What can you tell me?
scripts.translation: 你能告訴我什麼？

scripts.text: Tell me what you know!
scripts.translation: 告訴我你知道的一切！

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Yes. Right?
I'm going to tell you everything that I know.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
是的。對吧？
我會把我知道的一切都告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Sorry. I'm sorry.
I'm going to do what you want...
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
對不起。真的很抱歉。
我會照您說的做...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your attitude is a problem.
Let's take up the main subject.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的態度有問題。
我們言歸正傳吧。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I usually supply food
and other life necessities.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
我平時負責供應食物
和其他生活必需品。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I buy some food to eat for myself.
And I buy expensive food for him everyday.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
我會買些食物自己吃。
然後每天給他買很貴的食物。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
I think he is very fussy about food...
And I get money whenever I deliver food..
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
我覺得他對食物很挑剔...
而且我每次送食物都能拿到錢。

scripts.text: Where did you sleep?
scripts.translation: 你睡在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Yes? Yes, around here.
There is a place that soldiers stay.
He wants me to stay there...
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
嗯？是的，就在這附近。
那裡有個士兵駐紮的地方。
他讓我住在那裡...

scripts.text: When are you supposed to meet?
scripts.translation: 你們約好什麼時候見面？

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
In a couple of hours.
At a warehouse underground in the south.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
幾個小時後。
在南邊的地下倉庫。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanks for your cooperation.
Your house is in Rachel?
Estillda is your real name?
Yes, I'm going to draw his rations in Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你的配合。
你的家在拉赫嗎？
艾絲蒂爾達是你的真名嗎？
是的，我要去拉赫領取他的口糧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
To go back home without an accident.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
平安無事地回家。

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
Yes?
Please...
Don't kill me.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
嗯？
求求你...
別殺我。

scripts.text: - Estillda looks scared. You need to change the subject. -
scripts.translation: - 艾絲蒂爾達看起來很害怕。你需要換個話題。 -

scripts.text:
[Estillda]
We usually meet at the same place at the same time.
It's in a warehouse underground in the south.
Don't tell him that I told you.
scripts.translation:
[艾絲蒂爾達]
我們通常在同一時間、同一地點見面。
就在南邊的地下倉庫。
別告訴他我告訴過你。

scripts.text: This must be the place Estillda told me about.
scripts.translation: 這裡應該就是艾絲蒂爾達告訴我的地方。

scripts.text: Go inside.
scripts.translation: 進去看看

scripts.text: Observe the situation.
scripts.translation: 觀察情況

scripts.text:
You tried to open the door but it's locked.
It doesn't show any signs of life.
scripts.translation:
你試著開啟門，但門被鎖住了。
裡面沒有任何生命跡象。

scripts.text: Come back here later.
scripts.translation: 稍後再回來。

scripts.text: I back up to watch the situation unfold.
scripts.translation: 我退後一步，觀察事態發展。

scripts.text:
This must be the place Estillda told me about.
I have enough time for meeting.
scripts.translation:
這裡應該就是艾絲蒂爾達告訴我的地方。
我有足夠的時間赴約。

scripts.text:
An error has occurred.
Contact the GM team to resolve the situation.
scripts.translation:
發生了一個錯誤。
請聯絡GM團隊解決此問題。

scripts.text: You don't have to come here now.
scripts.translation: 你現在不必來這裡。

scripts.text:
[A man with black clothes]
You just arrived here.
Why are you so late?
Put your stuff down.
scripts.translation:
[一身黑衣的男子]
你才剛到這裡。
為什麼這麼晚？
把東西放下。

scripts.text:
[A man with black clothes]
May the goddess bless you eternally...
scripts.translation:
[一身黑衣的男子]
願女神永遠保佑你...

scripts.text:
[A man with black clothes]
Who... who are you?!
A... Assassin Guild?!
What?!
When did I give you a clue?!
scripts.translation:
[一身黑衣的男子]
你...你是誰？！
刺...刺客公會？！
什麼？！
我什麼時候給你線索了？！

scripts.text: You lost your head...
scripts.translation: 你失神了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is this the correct target?
Can you talk with me for a sec?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是正確的目標嗎？
能和我聊幾句嗎？

scripts.text:
[A man with black clothes]
No way!!!!
You... I'll make you close your eyes forever!
scripts.translation:
[一身黑衣的男子]
不可能！！！！
你...我要讓你永遠閉上眼！

scripts.text: - You can't continue this quest because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Eyah!
You... won't find anything.
Everything... is guided... by the goddess...
Keeek!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
哎呀！
你...什麼也找不到。
一切...都是...女神...指引的...
咳咳！

scripts.text: - He puts something in his mouth and swallows. -
scripts.translation: - 他把什麼東西放進嘴裡吞了下去。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is that?!
What do you have in your mouth...?
Why did you do that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那是什麼？！
你嘴裡有什麼...？
你為什麼要那樣做？

scripts.text:
It's too late to save him.
He passed away.
You find a key with a fancy decoration around his neck.
scripts.translation:
已經來不及救他了。
他已經去世了。
你在他脖子上發現了一把裝飾華麗的鑰匙。

scripts.text:
There is nothing to do.
Let's get out of here.
scripts.translation:
沒什麼可做的了。
我們離開這裡吧。

scripts.text: You are shoved by an unknown force.
scripts.translation: 你被一股未知的力量推開了。

scripts.text:
[Girke]
Oh~ young man.
I'm Girke Sara.
Just call me Girke.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾克]
哦~年輕男子。
我是吉爾克·薩拉。
叫我吉爾克就好。

scripts.text: - He smells like alcohol. -
scripts.translation: - 他聞起來有股酒味。 -

scripts.text:
[Girke]
You know what?
A man who is a legendary key artisan lives in our village.
Hiccup~
scripts.translation:
[吉爾克]
你知道嗎？
我們村裡住著一位傳奇的鑰匙工匠。
打嗝~

scripts.text:
[Girke]
Ah~hahahaha
My dad likes pieces of work like that.
One day, he said to me.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾克]
啊~哈哈哈
我爸爸喜歡那種作品。
有一天，他對我說。

scripts.text:
[Girke]
'Girke, my wish is having a key crafted from Oresa.'
scripts.translation:
[吉爾克]
“吉爾克，我的願望是擁有一把用奧雷薩製作的鑰匙。”

scripts.text:
[Girke]
But Oresa already disappeared after handing everything over to his apprentice.
Finally, my dad passed away without seeing such a key...
scripts.translation:
[吉爾克]
但奧雷薩在把一切都交給徒弟後就消失了。
最後，我爸爸沒能看到那樣的鑰匙就去世了...

scripts.text:
[Girke]
You know.
That Oresa! He lives in our town?!
Hiccup~
scripts.translation:
[吉爾克]
你知道嗎。
那個奧雷薩！他住在我們的城鎮？！
打嗝~

scripts.text:
[Girke]
But he is too old...
But the artisan is...
scripts.translation:
[吉爾克]
但他太老了...
那位工匠...

scripts.text:
[Girke]
...difficult to meet.
Like my dad... He's a bit of a loner.
scripts.translation:
[吉爾克]
...很難見到。
就像我爸爸...他有點孤僻。

scripts.text:
[Girke]
What am I talking to you about.
Are you drunken? Daddy... (sobbing)
Ah... Daddy...
scripts.translation:
[吉爾克]
我在跟你胡說什麼呢。
你喝醉了嗎？爸爸...（抽泣）
啊...爸爸...

scripts.text: - Girke starts to cry. -
scripts.translation: - 吉爾克開始哭泣。 -

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
I don't know why you are visiting me, but I'm not crafting anymore.
I'm too old to craft.
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
我不知道你為什麼來找我，但我已經不再製作東西了。
我太老了，做不了這些。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
That key is of a mansion built in a gorge of Veins.
I'm sure of it.
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
這把鑰匙是伯仁斯峽谷中一座豪宅的。
我確信這一點。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
It's an old story about that artisan.
Now... It's best to see my grandchild.
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
關於那位工匠，那是個老故事了。
現在...還是去看看我的孫子吧。

scripts.text: Do you know this key?
scripts.translation: 你認識這把鑰匙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
Hmm? Umm... Give it to me.
This pattern...
Where did you get this from?
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
嗯？唔...給我看看。
這個花紋...
你從哪裡得到的？

scripts.text: I just picked it up.
scripts.translation: 我只是撿到的。

scripts.text: I have a story...
scripts.translation: 我有故事要講...

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
Umm? Did you just pick it up?
That's impossible.
Did something happen in that house.
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
嗯？你只是撿到的？
這不可能。
那座房子裡是不是發生了什麼事。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
So what will you do with this key?
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
那你打算用這把鑰匙做什麼？

scripts.text: I'm going to find the owner.
scripts.translation: 我要找到它的主人。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
Ah~! That's why you came here to see me.
I gave that key to a person who was a priest.
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
啊~！原來你是為了這個才來見我的。
我把那把鑰匙給了一個曾經是牧師的人。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
I couldn't see my home after he became a priest, but I made a key for a celebration.
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
他成為牧師後，我就再也沒能回過家，但我為了慶祝而做了一把鑰匙。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
It's a key to his mansion.
Now I don't know where he lives.
But can you visit there and send over the caretaker of the summer cottage?
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
那是他豪宅的鑰匙。
現在我不知道他住在哪裡。
但你能去那裡看看，並通知一下夏屋的管家嗎？

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
I don't know what's going on.
I gave that key to a person who was a priest.
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
我不知道發生了什麼。
我把那把鑰匙給了一個曾經是牧師的人。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
I couldn't see my home after he became a priest, but I made a key for a celebration.
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
他成為牧師後，我就再也沒能回過家，但我為了慶祝而做了一把鑰匙。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
It's a key to his mansion.
Now I don't know where he lives.
But can you visit there and send over the caretaker of the summer cottage?
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
那是他豪宅的鑰匙。
現在我不知道他住在哪裡。
但你能去那裡看看，並通知一下夏屋的管家嗎？

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
Actually, I can't trust you...
But you showed up with a key. It may be an act of providence.
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
其實，我並不能完全信任你...
但你帶著鑰匙出現了。也許是天意。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
That mansion was...
built in a gorge of Veins.
I don't know the exact location of it though.
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
那座豪宅...
建在伯仁斯的峽谷裡。
不過我不知道確切的位置。

scripts.text: That should be enough.
scripts.translation: 這就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
Are you sure?
You are so kind.
Send over that key.
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
你確定嗎？
你真是太好了。
把鑰匙送過去吧。

scripts.text: - Find the owner of that key soon and tell Mayshell. -
scripts.translation: - 儘快找到那把鑰匙的主人，並告知梅謝爾。 -

scripts.text:
[Oresa Rava]
You are laughing now, but you will understand me soon.
scripts.translation:
[奧蕾莎·拉瓦]
你現在在笑，但很快你就會明白我的用意了。

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
You are here.
I'm Renzak.
You sent here from Mayshell?
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
你來了。
我是倫扎克。
是梅謝爾派你來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
You failed.
You must succeed.
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
你失敗了。
你必須成功。

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
You have to attain our goal and come out of the mansion's backdoor within 10 minutes.
You can do it.
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
你必須在10分鐘內達成目標，並從豪宅的後門出來。
你能做到的。

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
Our final target is over there.
The mansion is surrounded by cliffs.
You must remove the target in the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
我們的最終目標就在那裡。
豪宅被懸崖環繞。
你必須清除豪宅內的目標。

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
I'm going to give you 10 min.
Complete your task and then wait in the backdoor of the mansion.
I'll wait for you there.
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
我給你10分鐘。
完成任務後，在豪宅後門等待。
我會在那裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
You have to come out of the mansion's backdoor.
I'll wait for you.
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
你必須從豪宅的後門出來。
我會在那裡等你。

scripts.text: I got it.
scripts.translation: 明白了。

scripts.text: I'll be ready.
scripts.translation: 我準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
Wait a second.
Just wait until it gets dark.
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
等一下。
等到天黑再說。

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
It'll be easy to infiltrate because it's covered by the cliff's shadow.
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
因為懸崖的陰影遮蔽，滲透會更容易。

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
You don't have time to spare.
You should prepare for action.
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
你沒有多餘的時間。
你應該準備行動了。

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
You look good.
Me? I've always had the same figure.
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
你看起來不錯。
我？我一直保持這個身材。

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
I just wait for guys who will do what I ask.
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
我只是等待那些會照我要求行事的人。

scripts.text:
[Shadow-faced girl]
......
This road is blocked.
Go back.
scripts.translation:
[面帶陰霾的女孩]
......
這條路被堵住了。
請回去。

scripts.text: You don't have to come here.
scripts.translation: 你不必來這裡。

scripts.text: There is space on the bottom of the old fence.
scripts.translation: 舊圍欄的底部有空隙。

scripts.text: Find another way.
scripts.translation: 尋找其他途徑

scripts.text: Climb into the space.
scripts.translation: 爬進縫隙

scripts.text:
You climb into the narrow space.
The hole is blocked with the old barbed-wire entanglements.
scripts.translation:
你爬進了狹窄的縫隙。
洞口被舊鐵絲網堵住了。

scripts.text: It's a good bush to hide yourself.
scripts.translation: 這是一棵適合躲藏的大樹。

scripts.text:
[Priest from Rachel]
Are you from the Assassin Guild?
scripts.translation:
[來自拉赫的牧師]
你是刺客公會的成員嗎？

scripts.text:
[Priest from Rachel]
Who are you?
Get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[來自拉赫的牧師]
你是誰？
滾出去。

scripts.text:
[Priest from Rachel]
The reason that our organization was dissolved was because of you guys.
You are a thorough person?
scripts.translation:
[來自拉赫的牧師]
我們的組織被解散，都是拜你們所賜。
你們真是徹底啊？

scripts.text:
[Priest from Rachel]
Because of you, you ruined everything!
scripts.translation:
[來自拉赫的牧師]
因為你們，一切都毀了！

scripts.text:
[Priest from Rachel]
You want to destroy us forever!
I can't put the Goddess to shame on a dirty Odin!
scripts.translation:
[來自拉赫的牧師]
你們想永遠毀滅我們！
我不能讓女神在骯髒的奧丁面前蒙羞。

scripts.text:
[Priest from Rachel]
I'll never forgive you!!!
Pagan! Justice will be swift!
scripts.translation:
[來自拉赫的牧師]
我絕不會原諒你們！！！
異教徒！正義的審判即將降臨！

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
My peers will come here to settle this affair.
Go to Mayshell for the report.
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
我的同僚會來這裡處理這件事。
去梅謝爾那裡彙報。

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
Get the target!
Actually, I'm not supposed to be here. Is something wrong with you?
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
抓住目標！
其實我不該在這裡。你沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
You finished quickly.
Good job.
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
你完成得很快。
幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Renzak]
I told you that you have to finish within 10 minutes.
You might be exhausted.
Fortunately you are ok.
scripts.translation:
[倫扎克]
我告訴過你，必須在10分鐘內完成。
你可能已經精疲力竭了。
幸好你沒事。

scripts.text: - You can't continue this quest because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
I'm so tired...
You were sent by Mayshell?
Tell me why you came to see me.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
我好累...
你是梅謝爾派來的？
告訴我你為什麼來找我。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
......
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
......
有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Don't pursue only strength.
You'll get tired.
It's no better than living.
If you only seek power...
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
不要只追求力量。
你會感到疲憊。
這比活著更糟糕。
如果你只尋求權力...

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
What's going on with Daora?
Why are you in here?
Did I say you could come here?
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
達奧拉那邊怎麼樣了？
你為什麼在這裡？
我允許你進來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
What?
Hey, you aren't supposed to be here!
Get out now!
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
什麼？
嘿，你不該在這裡！
現在就走！

scripts.text: What is a Guillotine Cross?
scripts.translation: 什麼是十字斬首者？

scripts.text: I want to be a Guillotine Cross.
scripts.translation: 我想成為十字斬首者。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
.....

[Bercasell]
So you want to know about the Guillotine Cross?
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
所以你是想了解十字斬首者？
滾出去！

scripts.text: Just tell me...
scripts.translation: 告訴我吧...

scripts.text: [Bercasell]
scripts.translation: [貝卡塞爾]

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
It's funny that I'm talking to you like this.
I want to stop you from becoming a Guillotine Cross because of your defiance.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
我這樣跟你說話，真是可笑。
我之所以想阻止你成為十字斬首者，是因為你的反抗精神。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Yes, you don't ask questions.
That's good. You are qualified. What about being a Guillotine Cross?
Do you want to be a Guillotine Cross?
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
是的，你不問問題。
這很好，你具備資格。那麼，關於成為十字斬首者這件事？
你想成為十字斬首者嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, change my job.
scripts.translation: 是的，更換我的職業。

scripts.text: I need to think about it.
scripts.translation: 我需要再考慮一下。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
You don't regret it?
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
你不後悔嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
You can become a living offensive weapon.
Do you really want to become a Guillotine Cross?
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
你可以成為一件活著的進攻性武器。
你真的想成為十字斬首者嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, change my job.
scripts.translation: 是的，更換我的職業。

scripts.text: I need to rethink it.
scripts.translation: 我需要重新考慮。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
I cannot perform the job change.
Please remove your mount and try again.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
我無法執行職業更換。
請下馬後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
You still have unspent skill points.
Please use all your skill points and try again.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
你還有未使用的技能點。
請使用完所有技能點後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Is your decision final?
Good.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
你的決定是最終的嗎？
很好。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Now, you are an assassin, yet you are not an assassin anymore.
You are in the shadows, but it's different from the other shadows.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
現在，你是一名刺客，但又不完全是刺客。
你身處陰影之中，但這與其他陰影不同。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Your enemy is everything you can see.
Don't forget yourself.
A weight of the blood on your weapons.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
你的敵人是你所能看到的一切。
不要忘記你自己。
那是你武器上血液的重量。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Ok, change your clothes to your new uniform.
You are now a Guillotine Cross.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
好的，換上你的新制服。
你現在是一名十字斬首者了。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
A sword of the shadow...
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
陰影之劍...

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
And... these are presents to celebrate your becoming a Guillotine Cross.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
還有...這些是慶祝你成為十字斬首者的禮物。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
You are prudent. That's a good thing.
I'll wait for the day that you decide to join us as a Guillotine Cross.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
你很有遠見。這是好事。
我會等待你決定加入我們，成為十字斬首者的那一天。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
You are prudent. That's a good thing.
I'll wait for the day that you decide to join us as a Guillotine Cross.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
你很有遠見。這是好事。
我會等待你決定加入我們，成為十字斬首者的那一天。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
別煩我。

scripts.text:
......
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
......
有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: I want to be a Guillotine.
scripts.translation: 我想成為十字斬首者

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Do you?
What for...?
Of course, you came here with your own will...
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
是嗎？
為了什麼...？
當然，你是自願來到這裡的...

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Guillotine Cross is an enforcer of the Assassin Guild's laws.
Can you put a dagger in the back of one of your peers?
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
十字斬首者是刺客公會法律的執行者。
你能把短劍插進同伴的背嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
You are not ready to do it yet...
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
你還沒準備好...

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
別煩我。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Someday, it'll come back to you.
Well, I'm just a weapon, suppose I have no right to talk about life...
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
總有一天，你會明白的。
好吧，我只是一把武器，也許沒有資格談論生命...

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Or did Mayshell send you?
Or what, are you my fan?
You found the wrong place!
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
還是梅謝爾派你來的？
或者，你是我的粉絲？
你找錯地方了！

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Get out of here now!!!
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
現在立刻滾出去！！！

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Someday, it'll come back to you.
Well, I'm just a weapon, suppose I have no right to talk about life...
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
總有一天，你會明白的。
好吧，我只是一把武器，也許沒有資格談論生命...

scripts.text:
What?
Hey, you aren't supposed to be here!
Get out now!
scripts.translation:
什麼？
嘿，你不該出現在這裡！
馬上離開！

scripts.text:
Guillotine Cross is an enforcer.
A living offensive weapon...
scripts.translation:
十字斬首者是執行者。
是活著的進攻性武器...

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Who is an assassin's natural enemy?
Swordman? Priest?
Wizard?
Things of evil in great abundance?
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
刺客的天敵是什麼？
劍士？牧師？
巫師？
還是數量眾多的邪惡之物？

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
No, an assassin's natural enemy is other assassins.
The most threatening thing to us is us.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
不，刺客的天敵是其他刺客。
對我們威脅最大的，是我們自己。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
In the darkness of the guild, in the shadows we are the Guillotine Crosses.
We maintain the law and order within the Assassin Guild.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
在公會的黑暗中，在陰影裡，我們是十字斬首者。
我們維護刺客公會的法律與秩序。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
Sometimes we set examples for our peers, sometimes we aim swords at our members' necks in the name of the Guild.
We are the Guillotine Cross, the sword of the Assassin Guild.
scripts.translation:
[貝卡塞爾]
有時我們為同伴樹立榜樣，有時我們以公會之名將劍指向成員的咽喉。
我們是十字斬首者，是刺客公會的利劍。

scripts.text:
[Bercasell]
